// comment: Places, and the projects and datasets within them, shown on the index map. Run `npm run collect` to refresh data/projects.json, data/datasets.json and data/places.json. Each place has an id and a name; the map outlines it with the boundaries of the projects (or, in the Data section, datasets) within it, and the Projects and Data pages list them beneath it. A project is an object holding its repository URL as "repo", the id of its place as "place", and optionally a "siteUrl" for a site that is not at the usual /story address, and a "title" overriding the one taken from its description. A project or dataset may instead be held in this repository, as an object with "dir" naming its folder - holding project.md or dataset.md and, optionally, boundary.geojson - and "siteUrl" giving where it links to.
